question.text: Identify the incorrect statement regarding heavy water:

options.text: It reacts with  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  to form deuterated sulphuric acid  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> .
It is used as a coolant in nuclear reactors.

It reacts with  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  to produce  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> .

It reacts with  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  to produce  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> .

solution.text: Heavy water is used in moderator section of nuclear reactors to control the speed of neutrons due to its high moderating ratio, or it may be used for the preparation of deuterium.
